text:
Make every build session work the way a page's build session already does, so the Design page no longer shows any build sessions.

How it works today

A page's build session has its own page in Build (prelude/build): server/views/build/session.eta, answered by buildSessionPage in server/main.js. It shows the design page's chat beside the build's check, under a header that says it's a build session.
Two kinds of build still open on the design page instead: the app build (APP_GROUP) and the shell's layouts build (LAYOUTS_GROUP). isPageBuild in server/main.js leaves them out.
So the design page still carries parts that only build sessions use: - the chat's "This session builds …" notice (_chat.eta); - the "Next:" entry after each build turn (type: 'next', made in main.js and shown by _entry.eta); - the Build pill, with build sessions listed in the design's sessions menu; - the Design | App switch and App mode in the design bar (_design-bar.eta, _surface.eta).
What I want

Every build session opens in Build. That includes the app build and the shell's layouts build. Those two have no screens of their own, so where Build's session page shows the check, they need something else beside the chat. Propose what: for example, what the build changed and whether the app starts, with Open the app. Then design it in prelude/build (its views, routes and states) and add it to its NOTES.md.
Move "what's next" into Build's session page. It covers where the app is running and how to finish the branch. It should no longer be a transcript entry.
The design page keeps nothing of builds. List build sessions under Build, not in the design's sessions menu. A design's latest session (R-o4s) is never a build session.
The real app opens in its own window from Build (Open the app, Start the app). That's already decided in Build's notes, so App mode isn't needed on the design page.
Don't change the Design Workspace design (prelude/design-workspace): it removes its own build-specific parts once this is in. Record in prelude/build/NOTES.md what moved and why

I've finished reading. Here's what's there today and what I'd propose.

## How it works today

- **Which builds get Build's page.** `isPageBuild` (`server/main.js:2082`) leaves out `APP_GROUP` and `LAYOUTS_GROUP`. Those two then fall through to `sessionPage` at `main.js:2470` and open on the design page. Both belong to the shell design. The app build starts from the project page (`main.js:496`). The layouts build is a card on the shell's Build page (`main.js:898`).
- **"Next:".** `afterBranchTurn` adds a `type: 'next'` entry after every build turn (`main.js:1902-1918`). `_entry.eta:42-60` shows it. For a page build this partly repeats the check's "is built" notice (`build/_check.eta:28-33`).
- **Build pill and sessions menu.** `pageModel` lists every session with `build: true` (`main.js:1243-1250`), and `_chat.eta:28` adds the pill. The "This session builds …" notice is `_chat.eta:47-51`. On a build session's page the chat gets the same model, so the build session's menu also offers New session and design sessions.
- **Latest session (R-o4s).** `listSessions(dir)[0]` at `main.js:2298` can be a build session, and so can "Carry on from…" (`lastLine`, `main.js:1249`).
- **Build sessions on Build.** `_build.eta` only reaches the newest session per page (`buildView`'s `sessionOf`, `main.js:1964`). There's no list of all of them.

## What I propose for the app and layouts builds

One build session page (`build/session.eta`) with three kinds of build: `page`, `app` and `layouts`. Only the right-hand panel changes.

- **Page build:** the check, as now.
- **App build and layouts build:** a panel called **The build**. It has two parts and runs again after each turn, on the same `check-done` event:
  - **Whether the app starts.** After the turn, Prelude starts the branch's app and shows Starts (with its address), Doesn't start (with the start-up output folded below), or Not started. The toolbar has Open the app or Start the app (`_open-app`, as now).
  - **What the build changed.** The files changed on the branch since the session started, grouped as Added, Changed and Removed. For the layouts build, it also lists each of the shell's layouts as Built (naming the app's file, from `layouts.json`) or Not built yet. That's the layouts build's equivalent of the check.

**What's next.** For all three kinds, a "What's next" notice at the top of the panel replaces the transcript entry and the check's "is built" notice. It says one of:
- not built yet, so send the next message;
- doesn't render, or differs: fix it or approve it as built;
- built: where the app is running, with Open the app, then Merge into main or Push and open a pull request on the project page.

It would carry `firstPorted`'s line too.

**Sessions.** On a build session's page, the chat's menu lists only this design's build sessions, with no New session, since builds start from Build. Build gets a "Build sessions" section listing all of them, newest first. The design page lists none.

## What I'd change, on the branch

**In `prelude/build`:**
- `views`: add the panel and the "What's next" notice (`build/_result`, `build/_next`).
- `routes.json`: add `/sessions/:session/result`.
- `states/`: add two states on an App shell design, "app build" (the app doesn't start) and "layouts build" (built, app running). Give the existing sessions `build.kind: "page"`.
- `NOTES.md`: Decisions for the above, plus a "Moved from the design page, and why" section: the notice, the Next entry, the pill and the menu, and Design | App with App mode. Rewrite "For the Design Workspace" to match. Leave `prelude/design-workspace` alone.

**In the app (`server/`):**
- `main.js`:
  - drop `isPageBuild`'s exclusion, so every `session.build` gets `buildSessionPage`;
  - `buildSessionView` gets `kind` plus a result (start check, files changed, layouts);
  - `afterBranchTurn` stops returning `next`, and its model moves into the view;
  - `pageModel.sessions`, `lastLine` and R-o4s's `latest` skip build sessions;
  - `buildView` lists build sessions.
- Views:
  - `_entry.eta`: remove the `next` branch.
  - `_chat.eta`: remove the pill and the build notice.
  - `_design-bar.eta` and `_surface.eta`: remove Design | App and `appMode`. Remove `mode` from `surfaceOf`, and `inApp` in capture (`main.js:1430`).
  - `_build.eta`: add the sessions list.
  - `build/_check.eta`: the built notice becomes `_next`.

One open point to settle in the notes: whether "the app starts" is a new start-and-probe after each turn, or just what `appRunning` already reports. Saying "doesn't start" honestly needs the probe.
I have never actually run the app from Prelude, so I'm not sure. What do you recommend?

I recommend no new probe. Use the start that already happens after every build turn, and add a way to approve the app on the build session's page.

**Prelude already starts the app after each build turn.**
- After a build turn, the turn's check stops the app (`app.hosts.stop(folder)`, `server/main.js:1689`) and then renders the design (`reviewDesign`). That starts it again from the branch's code.
- The app Prelude runs is the design host. For an app build, it's the app the agent just wrote: per `server/hosts.js:3-4`, the app a first build creates "is its own design host".
- "Started" means the host answered `GET /__prelude/health` within 3 minutes. If it doesn't, it fails with the end of its log ("The design host stopped before it was ready", or "wasn't ready within 180s"; `hosts.js:135-145`).

So for the app and layouts builds, "whether the app starts" can be read from that check: Starts, at its address; Doesn't start, with that log folded below; or Not checked, saying why. That's one start per turn, as now, so nothing new stops another branch's app.

It means the app came up and answered Prelude's health check. It doesn't mean the app's own pages work with real data, so the panel shouldn't claim more than that. Open the app is how the person checks the rest.

**What you'll hit the first time.** The app only runs once you've approved it on this computer, because it runs the project's code unsandboxed (`hosts.js:31-34`). Until then the check stops with "needs your approval first. Approve it in the design bar" (`main.js:1692-1694`).

A first app build always writes new host settings, and approval is tied to the exact settings, so the first app build will always stop there. The approval is in the design bar, which is on the design page, not on Build's session page. So the build session needs its own way to approve.

**What I'd add to the proposal:**
- **`prelude/build`:** in "The build" panel, the start result has three outcomes: Starts, Doesn't start (with the log), and Needs your approval. The third shows the command it will run and an **Approve and start** button, as the design bar's approval does (`hostFor`, `main.js:1030`, posting to `/f/:id/host/approve`). Add a state for it ("the app build, waiting for approval"). Record the decision in `NOTES.md`: no separate probe; "starts" means it answered Prelude's health check.
- **In the app:** the check's result keeps the host's start outcome and log tail for the session, as `checkDone` already does for a page build's screens. Also reword the blocked message, which points at the design bar, to point at the build session.

Every build session now opens in Build, including the app build and the shell's layouts build, and the design page has nothing of builds left. I couldn't run anything, so none of it is tested. Run `node --test test/build.test.js test/app.test.js test/hosts.test.js`, then `npm test`.

**The cause:** in `server/main.js`, `isPageBuild` left out the app and layouts builds, so their sessions went to the design page. `afterBranchTurn` wrote the "Next:" entry, the design page's model listed every session including builds, and the design surface carried App mode.

**What changed:**
- **Every build opens in Build.** The app and layouts builds get a panel called "The build" beside the chat (`build/_result`). It shows:
  - whether the app starts: Starts, Doesn't start with what it printed, Waiting for you, or Not started;
  - for the layouts build, each layout as Built (naming the app's file) or Not built yet;
  - the files the build changed since the session started, as Added, Changed and Removed.
- **"Starts" is Prelude's own start after each turn, as agreed.** There's no separate probe. The result is kept in the session's `result.json`.
- **Approving the app.** The first app build always waits for approval. The session now offers "Approve and start the app", naming the command it runs, and the transcript note points there instead of the design bar. If the app doesn't start, "Ask the agent to fix it" also sends the agent what the app printed.
- **What's next** is a notice at the top of the check or the build panel (`build/_next`). It ends with "is built", Open the app, and Finish on the project page. It's no longer a transcript entry, and old "Next:" entries now show nothing.
- **Build lists the design's build sessions.** The design page's sessions menu, its latest session (R-o4s), "Carry on from…" and the page under a drawer or modal are design sessions only. A build session's chat lists only build sessions, with no New session.
- **App mode and the Design | App switch are gone** from the design surface, design bar and capture.
- **One line dropped:** the old "Next:" entry's line saying the design window now shows the app's own views. The check already shows which screens are built.

**The design (`prelude/build`):** I added the result routes and three new states on an App shell: app build waiting for approval, app doesn't start, and layouts built. The existing states got the new fields. `NOTES.md` has the decisions, a section on what moved from the design page and why, the app's notes, and a reworded paragraph for the Design Workspace. The fix's own notes are in `prelude/fixes/…/NOTES.md`.

**Tests:** these are rewritten or new:
- In `build.test.js`, the build session, what's next, the result panel, the list on Build, and what the build changed (`filesChangedSince`).
- In `app.test.js`, the app build's and layouts build's sessions, and the approval.
- In `hosts.test.js`, the test now checks there's no App mode.

Before this, `build.test.js` still checked the build session page for the design page's header and the "This session builds …" notice. Those checks had probably been failing since page builds moved to Build.

**Things to know:**
- I didn't touch `prelude/design-workspace`, as you asked. One of its states still has a build session and App mode, so its pages will differ from their approved screens on purpose.
- A build session started before this change has no record of where it began, so it lists the branch's changes since the branch began, and says so.
- I renamed the new state `08-app-won-t-start.json` to `08-app-doesnt-start.json` and emptied the old file so Prelude deletes it.
